transcript.text: Thanks everyone for being here. Could we start with those two reviews?

transcript.text: I need to flag a customer-success concern before we proceed. I confirmed with legal this morning that Northstar and Pine are covered by a pilot addendum requiring seven calendar days of customer notice before either account is enabled, and neither account has opted in. I haven't updated the launch ticket yet because legal confirmed the wording during a separate renewal review. We need to ensure neither Northstar nor Pine is included in the initial 10% cohort next Tuesday.

transcript.text: I need to give my platform-capacity review finding. transcript.speaker: A3
